Dialogue: Seriously, don't touch my flag. It's like… the only thing I own
You seem cool so I'll let you walk around
I really like pirates. They're so cool with their ships and swords and eyepatches.
I wanted to be a pirate too. I even tried to join a pirate crew, but they kicked me out saying I was too soft.
I don't think I'm soft! I mean, I can stand here for HOURS. That takes true grit, right?
If a actual pirate comes by, I'm gonna ask for an autograph before I tell them to back off.
It’s a good flag. I washed it last Tuesday. Smells like sea salt and cheap soap.
HEY! You... you just took my flag! Right in front of my face!
Wait... you didn't ask. You didn't buy it. You just... TOOK it!
Woah. Is THAT what pirates do?! They just take whatever they want?!
All this time I thought pirates were about standing guard and looking cool in hats...
But YOU! You're a real pirate! You took my only prized possession without hesitation!
You know what? You just opened my eyes. I've been doing this whole pirate thing wrong.
Why am I crying over one flag when I could be taking ENTIRE TREASURES?!
That's it! No more soft guard duty. I'm starting my life of crime today!
I'm gonna go rob an orphanage! Right now! Wish me luck
Thanks for stealing my flag dude! You changed my life!
